summary: Brazil Potash Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing details routine financial results, share-based compensation, warrants, and property, plant and equipment disclosures. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is announced. The filing is a standard periodic report by a foreign private issuer and does not relate to any corporate action that would qualify as a special situation.
